It then validates the availability of a corresponding `.deb` package by issuing a range request to the same domain before updating the `PKGBUILD` file with the new version and resetting `pkgrel` to 1. The script also attempts to extract the ONNX runtime version from the `.deb` archive for license tracking, using `bsdtar` and `strings`. While it downloads and inspects parts of the `.deb` file, it does not execute any fetched code or modify files outside the package build context. All network operations are directed to the official `crabnebula.app` domain, which aligns with the application's expected infrastructure. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, obfuscated code, or execution of remote scripts.

This script automates routine packaging tasks and operates within expected AUR maintainer workflows. Its behavior is consistent with benign helper scripts used to streamline package updates.
